svg.title: tropicalbee — Come in. Mind the spiders.
svg.desc: A block-built Halloween cottage in oak, cobblestone and forest green beneath a midnight-blue sky. The in-image Enter the House sign marks the game entrance. Two bats fly across the sky, flat clouds drift, leaves fall, a spider descends and a ghost bobs and blinks. A skeleton hand rests above the Enter the House sign and taps it in two short bursts per loop; the sign bounces on each tap. A flat pixel moon and the title text stay fixed; pumpkin faces flicker. Link this entire image to the included Markdown adventure.
